changes_made.explanation: Normalized task names to canonical forms, consolidated duplicate outputs, and added masked language modeling as an explicit NLG task. Removed abbreviated dataset names in favor of full canonical names used in the paper.
Normalized 'bits per character (BPC)' to 'BPC' and kept all other metrics as they are explicitly used to evaluate NLG outputs in the experiments.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper evaluates models using traditional automatic metrics and does not employ LLM-based evaluation.
The paper does not conduct any human evaluation of the generated outputs. All evaluation is done using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on NLG efficiency by introducing reservoir transformers with frozen random layers. It evaluates on machine translation and language modeling tasks using standard automatic metrics (BLEU, BPC, perplexity, accuracy). The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of task names and dataset references. The paper does not use LLM-as-judge or human evaluation methods.
